what_happened: The job asked to make the explainer site introduce Athena and fix newcomer findings. It was rejected. The verifier failed 1 of 7 acceptance criteria. The unmet criterion required the final report to contain a table mapping each criterion to evidence (a test name or HTML excerpt) and to record the results of the gate commands. The event lists no blocker or major findings and no failed checks. The site work itself was not reported as faulty. The gap was in the report.
cause: The report format was a criterion checked only by the final verifier. Nothing in the build required a criterion-to-evidence table or recorded gate results before the job was handed over. The build finished without a last pass against its own criteria, and the report was treated as free-form prose. So a missing deliverable surfaced only at the end, when rejection was the only option. This is an inference, because the stored fields show only the criterion text.
prevention: Add a pre-handoff check in the job runner. It should refuse to finish a build until the final report has one row for every acceptance criterion, each with non-empty evidence (a test name or HTML excerpt), plus a section with the exit status of each gate command. The check should list the criteria with missing rows. It would stop the whole class of criteria unmet at the end because the build skipped a self-check against them.
proposed_request: Before a job can be marked ready for final verification, make Athena check its final report mechanically. The report must contain a table with one row for each acceptance criterion in the accepted reading. Each row needs the criterion text and non-empty evidence (a test name or an HTML excerpt). The report must also record each gate command that was run and its result. If any criterion has no row or no evidence, or no gate results are recorded, the job must go back to the build with the missing items listed, not on to the verifier. Add tests that cover a complete report, a missing row, empty evidence and missing gate results. Then re-run the explainer site job so that its report passes this check.
